# kVis Project Guidance

- Keep the project in plain modern JavaScript; do not introduce Python or TypeScript.
- The browser visualization uses Vite and Three.js.
- Implement one user-visible milestone at a time; do not add kRPC, telemetry, trajectory, or recording features until requested as the next step.
- Keep the current preview useful without a running KSP instance.
- Run `npm run build` after code changes.
